g.text: RLinf PickCube SAC: new evaluation seeds and a fresh training seed
Each checkpoint: evaluation seeds 4001/4002/4003, 160 trajectories each. Circles: aggregate; crosses: seed means.
Lines connect evaluated checkpoints only. The 3,000-iteration budget has one training seed.
Seed 1234 used checkpoint recovery; seed 4321 did not. This comparison cannot isolate recovery-path effects.
